title: Derivative of the graph-plane projection at A = 0
statement: For natural numbers n, l, H in L(R^n, R^l), x in R^n and y in R^l, with Pi(A) = starProjection of span{graphPoint v (A v) : v in R^n} and DPi(0) = fderiv R Pi 0: DPi(0)[H](graphPoint x y) = graphPoint (sum_{i<n} <H e_i, y> e_i) (H x), where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 in R^n. (In block form with respect to R^n x R^l, DPi(0)[H] = [[0, H^T],[H, 0]].)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (H : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), fderiv ℝ (fun A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection) 0 H (graphPoint x y) = graphPoint (∑ i : Fin n, inner ℝ (H (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) y • EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (H x)
